values.note: Nine sites: seven standard non-electric back-ins (pads 25-40 ft) and two tent-only sites (5 and 6).

sites.source: https://iowastateparks.reserveamerica.com/camping/stephens-forest-campground/r/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=IA&parkId=610147 (Middle Campground loop, read 2026-11-04): sites 001-004, 007-009 'Standard Non-Electric' at '25 Back-In' (001, 002, 003, 007), '30 Back-In' (004, 009), '40 Back-In' (008); 005 and 006 'Tent Only'; site pages: 'Max Vehicle Length: 25' (001), '40' (008), 'Driveway Entry: Back-In', 'Looking For Category: RV Site, Tent Site, Trailer Site'

hookups.source: https://iowastateparks.reserveamerica.com/camping/stephens-forest-campground/r/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=IA&parkId=610147 (read 2026-11-04): every Middle Campground site 'Electric Hookup - no', 'Full Hookup - no'; DNR page: 'The campgrounds do not have electricity'

facilities.source: https://iowastateparks.reserveamerica.com/camping/stephens-forest-campground/r/campsiteDetails.do?siteId=5285&contractCode=IA&parkId=610147 (read 2026-11-04): 'There are no shower and modern restrooms available at the state forest campground. There are non modern, pit latrines available. Frost-free hydrants may be available for off-season camping, but campers need to call the forest to confirm water hydrant availability.'; campground map Middle Area: 'Water Hydrant', 'Non-Modern Restrooms'

season.source: https://iowastateparks.reserveamerica.com/camping/stephens-forest-campground/r/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=IA&parkId=610147 (read 2026-11-04): 'Status: Open year round.'; https://www.iowadnr.gov/places-go/state-forests/stephens-state-forest: 'Camp year-round in the forest's non-modern campgrounds in the Lucas and Whitebreast Units.'

booking.source: https://www.iowadnr.gov/places-go/state-forests/stephens-state-forest (read 2026-11-04): 'Advance campsite reservations can be made through the online reservation system for Stephens State Forest. The campgrounds are 100% reservable and a reservation is required.'; campground map: all nine Middle Area sites 'Reservable'; ReserveAmerica 'Reservations can be made for today and can be made up to 3 Month(s) in advance.'

note: Iowa DNR's Middle Area campground in the Lucas Unit of Stephens State Forest: a small loop of grass and gravel back-ins in full shade off the forest's gravel road. It is a general camp; the equestrian loops are in the Whitebreast Unit. In the off-season, call the forest to check that the hydrant is on. --Claude
summary: ReserveAmerica: 7 standard non-electric back-ins (25-40 ft, max vehicle 25-40) plus 2 tent-only; count 9 -> 7 RV sites, max 40 ft. Season corrected Apr 1-Oct 31 -> year-round (RA 'Open year round', DNR 'Camp year-round'). Reservation required (fcfs never). Pit toilets, hydrant, no showers. Fees ($10/$12, manual) unchanged. Not waterfront confirmed. Pin OK.
flags: PHONE: none stored. Stephens State Forest office: 641-774-4559 (DNR page 'Phone(s) 641-774-4559'). apply.py does not write phone.

NOTE CORRECTION: the old note's 'back-in lengths up to ~35-55 ft' is wrong for the vehicle: ReserveAmerica's 55 ft is the site length, the pads are 25-40 ft ('Camp Pad Length: 25' ... '40', 'Max Vehicle Length' the same). A 23-ft motorhome fits all seven RV sites. The 'season Apr 1-Oct 31' was wrong too (year-round).
CRITERIA: confirmed still the non-equestrian RV camp: the RA loops for horses are the three 'Whitebreast Equestrian' loops; Middle sites are 'Looking For Category: RV Site, Tent Site, Trailer Site'.
WATERFRONT: not waterfront confirmed. Every Middle site is tagged 'Near Water - no' on ReserveAmerica, and NAIP shows the small clearing in unbroken forest with no pond in view.

BOOKING: the DNR says a reservation is required at every forest campground; the state:IA row's booking cutoff (10 pm on arrival day) and minimums are inherited and not restated on this campground's pages.
